name: Demo · Vaccine · VAX-118 (Phase III)
description: Single injection, adults 60+. Strict cold chain 2-8 C; Day 29 blood sample is key; 7-day e-diary; SAEs within 24 hours.

topics.major: SAE follow-up report overdue; PI causality not documented
topics.critical: SAE unreported, or reported outside 24 hours (stays critical even with a CAPA)

topics.major: AEs missing from EDC or not graded. (The PI not assessing AEs is PI_OVERSIGHT, a separate problem.)

study_rules: Administering a dose exposed to an unapproved temperature excursion is an important protocol deviation. [TEMP_EXCURSION, critical if broken] (protocol VAX-118 Version 1.2, p. 2)

Any temperature excursion must be reported to the sponsor within 1 calendar day, and affected doses must be quarantined and must not be administered until the sponsor approves their use. [TEMP_EXCURSION, major if broken] (protocol VAX-118 Version 1.2, p. 2)
The Day 29 visit must occur within plus or minus 3 days. [PROTOCOL_DEVIATION, minor if broken] (protocol VAX-118 Version 1.2, p. 3)
A missed Day 29 immunogenicity sample is an important protocol deviation. [PROTOCOL_DEVIATION, major if broken] (protocol VAX-118 Version 1.2, p. 3)
Diary completion on fewer than 5 of the 7 days requires retraining of the subject and is a minor deviation. [PROTOCOL_DEVIATION, minor if broken] (protocol VAX-118 Version 1.2, p. 4)
All serious adverse events must be reported to the sponsor within 24 hours of the site becoming aware of the event. [SAE_REPORTING, critical if broken] (protocol VAX-118 Version 1.2, p. 5)
Guillain-Barre syndrome is an adverse event of special interest and must be reported within 24 hours. [SAFETY_REPORTS, critical if broken] (protocol VAX-118 Version 1.2, p. 5)
